concepts.name: Quiet Folio
concepts.description: An editorial broadsheet — vast paper, one massive serif headline, products as still life. Letterspaced caps as the only ornament.
concepts.frontPrompt: Editorial broadsheet homepage hero (above-the-fold) for an online sleep apothecary called 'Hours'. Theme: lunar, hushed, ceremonial — a 1920s alchemist's notebook reimagined. Featuring valerian tonic, chamomile honey, ceramic sleep cup, beeswax candle. Massive Didone serif headline reading HOURS taking 70 percent of viewport width with ultra tight tracking; below it a tiny italic subhead 'a sleep apothecary'. The page is 90 percent empty paper. Off-white #f6f1e6 background, deep ink #15110d type, a single brass accent on a single thin horizontal rule. Tiny tracked-out caps navigation across the top reading RITUALS · CATALOGUE · NOTES · STOCKIST. One small product still-life photograph — an amber glass tonic bottle and a small ceramic cup — placed right of the headline, low and small. No buttons, only underlined text links. Visible page margins like a print broadsheet. The image must look like a high-fidelity desktop browser screenshot of a real website homepage — not a moodboard, not abstract collage, not a single product photograph. Show a navigation bar, page header, hero composition with typography at realistic web sizes, and crisp clean edges. Render at full 16:9 desktop browser viewport, full-bleed. No watermarks, no garbled text, no people.
